I have never gone to school, but I know this land from my mother and from my own two hands. This beans plot is small — less than half a hectare — and I will put goat manure on it because the land is ours and manure does not cost money like chemical fertilizer. I will sow the seeds I kept from last harvest, and my children and I will do all the work ourselves because I have no spare cash to pay laborers. I do not buy chemicals for beans because beans find their own food from the air, and those bottles cost too much when my children need to eat.
